newsitem.title: CHILE: Santander keeps Chilectra buy rating.
newsitem.headline: Santander keeps Chilectra buy rating.

text.p: Santander Investment said it was maintaining its buy recommendation on Chilean power distributor Chilectra, although it has downgraded its earnings estimate for 1996 and 1997.
The lower profits are the result of an annual noncash goodwill charge of $14 million generated by the purchase of Brazilian distributor Cerj, said the report.
"We expect Cerj to fuel earnings growth in 1998, when efficiency gains should boost profits," said the study by analyst Eleonore Lefebure.
Santander forecast net earnings for 1996 of $159 million, down three percent on its previous estimate. It cut its forecast of net earnings for this year by 17 percent to $147.2 million.
Profits are expected to climb to $190.2 million in 1998, according to the report.
